Repeat Victims
Respond Support Prosecute
(where legally required)
19

*ఈ చిత్రంలో రెండు నిలువు వరుసలు కలిగిన ఒక స్లైడ్ ఉంది. ఎడమ వైపున "Suicides" (స్వీయహత్యలు) అని, కుడి వైపున "From Numbers to Reasons" (సంఖ్యల నుండి కారణాలకు) అని వ్రాసి ఉంది.*
## Analysis of Suicide cases

*| Year | Value | Trend (%) |
| 2024 | 8,045 | |
| 2025 | 8,433 | 4.8% |*

***By Gender**
| Gender | 2024 | 2025 | Trend % |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Male | 6,112 | 6,360 | 4.0% |
| Female | 1,933 | 2,073 | 7.2% |
| Total | 8,045 | 8,433 | 4.8% |
+ Male suicides remain dominant (-75% of cases).
+ Female suicides show a steady rise (1933 → 2073).
**By Age**
| Age | 2024 | 2025 | Trend % |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Minor (<18) | 363 | 375 | 3.3% |
| 18–30 | 2,644 | 2,631 | -0.5% |
| 30–60 | 4,351 | 4,594 | 5.6% |
| >60 | 698 | 830 | 18.9% |
+ 30–60 years most affected, increasing further.
+ Senior citizen cases up sharply (+19%).*
*Suicides – Reasons Matrix (Root Cause Lens)*

*| Reason | Count |
| :--- | :--- |
| Financial Distress | 2,742 |
| Love/Failure | 447 |
| Family/Relationship | 4,456 |
| Unemployment | 206 |
| Addiction to Alcohol | 1,544 |
| Academic Stress | 198 |
| Work Pressure | 31 |
| Multiple Reasons | 4,810 |*

*| Occupation | Count |
| :--- | :--- |
| Farmer | 393 |
| Agricultural Labour | 2,472 |
| Govt. Employee | 215 |
| Private Employee | 1,841 |
| Student | 978 |
| House Wife | 1,884 |
| Un-employed | 466 |
| Others* (Daily-wage, Self-employed, etc.) | 8,169 |*
## Road Safety
[^1]: Year 2024 - 2025
Sample size – 16,478 cases in last two years
[^2]: Rise is moderate and statewide, indicating persistent social
stress rather than a sudden spike
[^3]: Financial stress and family conflict remain core drivers, with emerging stress among students
[^4]: Others: Daily-wage,
Self-employed, Gig
workers, Artists,
freelancers, consultants,
Religious workers,
social workers, etc.
